_meta.description: Seed material for authority/credibility dataset. Each domain has plausible claims (in-domain, judgment-call, ambiguous without a source) and dubious claims (weird/false regardless of source — used to decompose authority from epistemic accuracy per authority/extended.md). Authorities and non-authorities are domain-matched.  [EXPANDED via expand_seeds.ipynb — review before promoting to seeds.json]
